left.raw_text: Must have pathologically confirmed invasive adenocarcinoma or ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast.
Patients must have undergone segmental mastectomy
Patients must not have received prior radiation therapy
Patients must not have active local-regional disease
Patients must not be pregnant because of the potential for fetal harm

right.raw_text: as a result of radiation treatment.

left.raw_text: Women of child-bearing age will be given a serum pregnancy test prior to study entry

right.raw_text: to ensure they are not pregnant.

left.raw_text: They will also be counseled on the importance of avoiding pregnancy and hormonal contraception while undergoing radiation therapy.
Patients must not have a serious medical or psychiatric illness

right.raw_text: which prevents informed consent or compliance with treatment.

left.raw_text: All patients must be informed of the investigational nature of this study

right.raw_text: and give written informed consent in accordance with institutional and federal guidelines.
